Service Law: Rajasthan Medical & Health Subordinate Service Rules, 1965 – Restitution – Appellants, working as Auxiliary Nursing & Midwifery or Lab Technician, Multi-Purpose Worker, Accounts Clerk and other similarly situated posts, applied for the course of General Nursing applications as in-service candidates and also applied for study leave – Writ petitions by the appellants praying that the study leave sanctioned to them by the competent authority may be treated as on deputation – Single Judge allowed the petitions – Intra-court appeal
